title: CrossCountry train services resume after outage
summary: CrossCountry train services resumed after a major weekend rail disruption, bringing the national network back to normal operations.
content: It follows major national rail disruption at the weekend.

zh.summary: CrossCountry列车服务在周末重大铁路故障后恢复运营，使国家铁路网络恢复正常运营。

title: Shein aims for almost $27bn valuation in stock market debut
summary: Fast-fashion retailer Shein targets a nearly $27 billion valuation as it prepares for its Hong Kong stock exchange listing on September 1.
content: The fast-fashion giant's shares are due to start trading in Hong Kong on 1 September.

zh.title: Shein目标在股票市场首次亮相时估值接近270亿美元
zh.summary: 快时尚零售商Shein目标估值近270亿美元，为其9月1日香港股票交易所上市做准备。

title: Singapore inflation hits highest in nearly two years, but undershoots expectations
summary: Singapore's inflation reached its highest level in nearly two years at 2.2% in August, but came in below economists' 2.3% forecast, suggesting potential price pressure relief.
content: Consumer prices rose 2.2% last month, compared with the 2.3% expected by economists polled by Reuters

zh.title: 新加坡通货膨胀创近两年新高，但低于预期
zh.summary: 新加坡8月通货膨胀率达到近两年来最高水平2.2%，但低于经济学家预期的2.3%，表明可能出现价格压力缓解。

title: Kids food scheme set to grow after 'crazy' support
summary: The Grumpy Cook, a children's food charity in Hastings, is expanding after receiving £30,000 in donations, demonstrating strong public support for food security initiatives.
content: The Grumpy Cook in Hastings is set to expand its scheme after receiving £30,000 in donations.

title: Nearly three million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
summary: Nearly 3 million Teslas face recall in China due to hidden door handle issues, alongside similar recalls for Chinese automakers XPeng, Xiaomi, and Geely.
content: Other brands affected by the recall include Chinese carmakers XPeng, Xiaomi and Geely.

title: Fund manager lists four of his best-value unloved stocks to swerve the AI hype
summary: A Ranmore Fund Management analyst recommends undervalued stocks in consumer brands and Asian tech as alternatives to the current artificial intelligence investment hype.
content: From consumer brands to Asian tech, Ranmore Fund Management's Sean Peche shares some of his top unloved stock picks.

title: U.S. to unveil 'greatest financial offensive' against Iran as Tehran threatens ship seizures
summary: The U.S. announced major financial sanctions against Iran as diplomatic efforts collapsed, with a 60-day ceasefire window expired and no resolution in sight for the ongoing conflict.
content: The escalation came as both sides have missed a 60-day ceasefire window to reach a deal, closing off the formal truce mechanism to end the six-month war.

title: Alibaba plunges after announcing $10.2 billion share placement to fund AI push
summary: Alibaba stock dropped 10% following announcement of a $10.2 billion share offering to fund its expanding artificial intelligence operations.
content: Alibaba shares plunged 10% after the tech giant priced a $10.2 billion share placement to fund its growing AI investments.

title: Stock futures flat as U.S. and Canada appear headed for trade war
summary: U.S. stock-index futures remained stable as the country appeared poised to enter a trade war with Canada, a major trading partner. The potential conflict raises concerns about economic impacts on both nations. Investors were monitoring developments as markets opened the trading week.
content: U.S. stock-index futures were little changed on Sunday, as it appeared the U.S. was on the verge of an all-out trade war with Canada, one of its biggest trading partners.

zh.title: 股票期货持平，美国和加拿大似乎走向贸易战
zh.summary: 美国股指期货保持稳定，因为该国似乎准备与主要贸易伙伴加拿大进入贸易战。潜在冲突引发人们对两国经济影响的担忧。投资者在市场开盘交易周时密切监测动向。

title: Oil prices fall as investors await 'toughest' U.S. sanctions on Iran
summary: Oil prices declined Monday as investors awaited details of the U.S. government's announced "toughest-ever" sanctions campaign against Iran. The sanctions are expected to have significant implications for global energy markets. Market participants remain cautious pending official details from Washington.
content: Oil prices fell Monday as investors awaited details of what Washington has billed as its toughest-ever sanctions campaign against Iran.

zh.title: 油价下跌，投资者等待美国对伊朗的最严厉制裁
zh.summary: 周一油价下跌，投资者等待美国政府宣布对伊朗的有史以来最严厉制裁活动的详细信息。这些制裁预计将对全球能源市场产生重大影响。市场参与者对华盛顿的官方细节持谨慎态度。
